name: Nemesis
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (9 November 2000), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/free-agent-nemesis-2000-11-09.html: Nemesis, the former mastermind of the Brotherhood and first Gyeah Wrestling Heavyweight Champion, announces that he is a free agent and cuts an interview with Marc Osborne on Damien King, Jason Hawke and Psycho Soup.
caption: A founder and the former mastermind of the Brotherhood and the first Gyeah Wrestling Heavyweight Champion, a free agent from November 2000.
